review_notes: Not linked. None of the counterexample or equality-example constructions is stated in the challenge.
reception_summary: No expert evaluation or error report was found. Human arXiv work from July-September 2026 proves overlapping cases under extra hypotheses. Dong proves the Penrose conjecture under a 2-convexity condition, Dolmen the charged version with Reissner-Nordström rigidity under the same condition, and Ng a charged inequality with a suboptimal constant. FTL290 does not appear to cite these. The community notes flag scope limits (3D dyonic data; the higher-dimensional case depends on another theorem). No
